summary: Reverified the reviewed keycap implementation (8a7aebc6, unchanged src/ui/keycap.rs) for this execution: F02 press compression and hover badge plus F04 arrow geometry and drawn accent hexes still pass the scoped loop and the full gate, with no source changes.

KEYCAP-TACTILE-FEEDBACK.evidence: KeycapMode::Pressed paints the box deflated to 0.95 about its centre (76x76 inside the allocated 80x80, so the grid never reflows) plus the two-layer inset-shadow approximation, and hover paints the 20x20 SURFACE circle with the INDIGO_200 hairline and #4338ca pencil at the reference's -4px top-right offset. Pinned by the widget-level tests the_pressed_box_deflates_to_scale_95, the_pressed_keycap_paints_the_deflated_box_and_its_inner_shadow, and the_edit_badge_hangs_off_the_top_right_corner_on_hover, all re-executed in this execution's egui-ui run.

KEYCAP-ARROW-GEOMETRY.evidence: The legend arrow keeps the CanvasIcon line-and-chevron coordinates (0.15s stroke padding, 0.7s stem, 0.28s chevron arms) and strokes a cap disc at every vertex to reproduce lineCap/lineJoin round, which epaint 0.36.2 has no primitive for. The resting ink comes from the reference's drawn hexes via Direction.ink (UP #2563eb, LEFT #6366f1, RIGHT #9333ea, DOWN #7c3aed), separated from the class-based mode colour the fill keeps. Pinned by the_arrow_keeps_the_canvas_icon_geometry_with_round_caps and direction_arrow_inks_are_the_reference_drawn_literals, both re-executed in this execution's egui-ui run.

risks: Native visual confirmation is outside this execution: the drawn shapes and literals are pinned by egui_kittest widget tests, but no on-screen session validated the pressed compression, the inset-shadow softness, or the badge placement at DPI.
The reference's hover transition-opacity (150ms fade) is not reproduced; the badge appears discretely on hover.

CSS shadow-inner has no epaint primitive, so it is approximated with two translucent inside strokes, and the drawn arrow/pencil hexes live in keycap.rs because no theme token owns that lineage (theme.rs was outside this task's ownership).
